name: Hua Guofeng
contribution: A Chinese politician who served as chairman of the Chinese Communist Party and the premier of China.
legacy: After the death of Zhou Enlai in January 1976, Mao elevated this person to the positions of premier and first vice chairman of the CCP, which made him Mao's designated successor.

checks.lead: Hua Guofeng (born Su Zhu (苏铸); 16 February 1921 – 20 August 2008; also spelled as Hua Kuo-feng) was a Chinese politician who served as chairman of the Chinese Communist Party and the premier of China. As the successor of Mao Zedong, Hua held the top offices of the government, party, and the military after the deaths of Mao and Premier Zhou Enlai, but was gradually forced out of power between December 1978 and June 1981, and subsequently retreated from the political limelight, though still remaining a member of the Central Committee until 2002.
